quests.title: Keep The Lights On
quests.description: Pell Ormond owns the building and the debt. Survive your first week without owing him more than 500.
quests.consequence: The Landlord stops treating you like a temporary tenant.

quests.title: Three Clean Jobs
quests.description: Ilse Hartmann wants proof your hands are worth teaching.
quests.consequence: Ilse shows you how to close a wound so it stays closed.

quests.title: Another Pair Of Hands
quests.description: One person can't run a clinic. Make room and hire someone.
quests.consequence: Someone else can take the easy jobs while you sleep.

quests.title: The Card Under The Door
quests.description: The Undermarket finds you when you're worth finding. Build street rep until a fixer calls.
quests.consequence: The den behind the noodle stall opens for you.

quests.title: A Name In The Sump
quests.description: Rep keeps the door busy and the inspectors curious.
quests.consequence: Better-paying customers start to ask for you by name.

quests.title: A Second Address
quests.description: One room is a hideout. Two is a practice.
quests.consequence: Your name now spans districts.

quests.title: Fit Out
quests.description: Make the room work: install upgrades that change how jobs go.
quests.consequence: The clinic stops looking temporary.

quests.title: Locks And Lenses
quests.description: Raids, informants, thieves. See them coming.

objective.text: Reach security 4 at your active clinic

quests.consequence: Fewer surprises at the door.

quests.title: The Courier's Eye
quests.description: Wire's courier needs untraceable chrome. Install a black-market implant.
quests.consequence: Wire starts sending you her better customers.

quests.title: Liquid Chrome
quests.description: Turn salvage into credit through the Undermarket.

objective.text: Sell 3 items on the black market

quests.consequence: The brokers learn your face.

quests.title: Blood Debts
quests.description: Mother's crews remember who stitched them up.
quests.consequence: The Belt gets quieter around your door.

quests.title: Clean Hands For Aegis
quests.description: Aegis Meridian pays well for discreet field work.
quests.consequence: Aegis patrols start skipping your street.

quests.title: Teo's Coat
quests.description: Teo wants to be a real surgeon. Give him the work.
quests.consequence: Teo earns a ripperdoc's coat.

quests.title: A Real Team
quests.description: Three people who trust each other with a scalpel.
quests.consequence: Your clinics can run without you.

quests.title: Regulars
quests.description: Some faces come back. That's how a practice survives.
quests.consequence: Regulars send their friends.

quests.title: The Butcher's Shadow
quests.description: Silas Dune wants your market. Settle it: partner with him or ruin him.

objective.text: Resolve the rivalry with Silas Dune

quests.consequence: Furnace Line stops being a war zone.

quests.title: Paper Chains
quests.description: You owe money now. Every credit you owe Pell is a leash. Cut it.
quests.consequence: The Landlord has to find someone else to squeeze.

quests.title: Stabilisers
quests.description: Voss's kits are in your cabinet. Install three neural implants for Lyra's 'programme'.
quests.consequence: Lyra's numbers look good. Your patients' fevers do not.

quests.title: Patient Zero
quests.description: Noor Sayeh carries a lattice nobody should have survived. Keep them safe until you know what THREAD is.
quests.consequence: You know what Lyra built. Now you have to decide what to do with it.

quests.title: Into The Light
quests.description: Ilse built THREAD. Moor can take it to a tribunal. Get her the evidence, or decide it's not worth the fire.

objective.text: Decide what happens to the THREAD evidence

quests.consequence: Caldera will be talking about this for years.

quests.title: Consequence
quests.description: Everything you did comes back. Face it.

objective.text: Reach the end of your story

quests.consequence: The end of one story.
